ui_the_online_gallery_could_not_be_loade.reason: linja sona (information cord/line) is not sufficiently clear for the user’s network connection in this error/instruction. The gallery noun phrase is acceptable contextually, but does not resolve this separately consequential troubleshooting ambiguity. No independently supported precise correction established in this pass; retain fallback.

basis.source: Read actual English catalogue and checked direct Kotlin R.string consumers in merged470 base /tmp/locale-twentyseventh/source; all seven proposals absent from443 original Toki Pona entries. No original changed.
basis.gallery_expression: ma pi sitelen mute is a new compositional description, literally a place of many images, not an established or externally authenticated technical term. In the gallery/source-image workflow it is intelligible and distinguishes the source picture collection from the assembly kulupu sitelen. Accept it consistently in the four source-image labels/errors; do not infer suitability as a universal gallery term outside this context.
basis.ui_gallery_image: Fallback title/source-image description, also used in credit output when a title is empty. It names the image only, does not alter author, licence or attribution requirements. Spaces are acceptable in this descriptive fallback label.
basis.memory: RAM parenthetical explicitly retains the technical referent. Insufficient-memory inspection phrasing is directly parallel to existing ui_not_enough_memory_to_inspect_this_image, with source qualifier added. No new memory-budget or decoding claim.
basis.unavailable: sina ken ala kepeken conveys inability to use, not that the file or source never exists; appropriate for file/provider/source validation failure.
basis.language_names: toki Inli and toki Nijon are recognizable conventional language-name forms; anu preserves English-or-Japanese alternatives. Search action uses o alasa consistent with current caption. This is not certification of artwork/search-result translation.
basis.artwork_instruction: lipu sitelen is the picture/artwork page in this explicit gallery navigation context, rather than the raw downloaded image. lon tenpo open plus ni la preserves first/then sequence. luka e nena is a contextual button-press instruction; the quoted o kepeken e sitelen exactly matches current gallery_use_image. Existing nena elsewhere means corner/projection and is not evidence by itself for this button meaning.
basis.prior_rejections: Download-too-large does not specify bytes/data rather than dimensions. External link draft does not establish hyperlink meaning of bare linja. Both remain fallback.
